# Credits

## Game assets

**All game content is original and generated by this project's code**: no third-party art, models,
textures, sounds or music are used.

| Content | How it is made | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Textures (concrete, tiles, plaster, painted/rusty metal, wood, fabric, gun finishes, decals) | GPU shaders at load time (noise, Voronoi, procedural normal and ORM maps) | `src/assets/textures/` |
| Weapons (15), operators, props, light fixtures | Code-modeled geometry (beveled boxes, extrusions, lathes) | `src/assets/models/`, `src/assets/geometry/` |
| Map: Sublevel 9 | Hand-authored level data | `src/game/world/sublevel9.ts` |
| Sound effects, ambience, music loops | Synthesized with the Web Audio API (OfflineAudioContext) | `src/engine/audio/` |
| UI icons and the favicon | CSS/SVG drawn in code | `src/ui/`, `index.html` |

Weapon, operator and place names are invented. Any resemblance to real products is unintended;
no trademarked content is used.

## Fonts (SIL Open Font License 1.1)

Self-hosted from npm via [Fontsource](https://fontsource.org) (packages are MIT; the fonts are OFL-1.1):

- **Big Shoulders Stencil Display**: Patric King and The Big Shoulders Project Authors
- **Barlow Condensed**: Jeremy Tribby and The Barlow Project Authors
- **Share Tech Mono**: Carrois Type Design, Ralph du Carrois
